self_contained_arguments: Dual-number derived lifting of a sheaf is a flat sheaf, by tensoring0->C->R->C->0.
Cyclicity away from D recovers a flat embedded support through the annihilator.
Cech embedded obstruction equals the normal projection of Kodaira-Spencer.
An affine smooth first-order deformation trivializes noncanonically, so every finite D lifts whenever Z lifts.
Regular-immersion Koszul and local finite resolutions make the pushed-forward ideal perfect.
